title: How Web Research Agents Interpret User Priorities
abstract: arXiv:2611.22989v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Web research agents gather information online and write cited reports, including financial analysis. Users can state a priority to guide this research, but a priority may not say how to judge the options, leaving the agent to choose the criteria. We examine how two such agents, built on OpenAI and Anthropic models, interpret a stated priority. In 36 runs, the agents compared Microsoft and Alphabet as businesses. Prompts asked for special attention to growth or resilience, or gave no priority. We analyzed reports, searches, returned sources and cited sources. Of the 24 reports given a priority, 21 focused on it, but their criteria varied. Under the growth priority, OpenAI reports that ranked the companies accounted for risk or predictability and favored Microsoft, while the Anthropic ones judged growth by its pace and favored Alphabet. translated_title: 网络研究智能体如何解读用户优先级
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.22989v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：网络研究智能体在线收集信息并撰写带引用的报告，包括金融分析。用户可以声明一个优先级来指导这项研究，但优先级未必说明如何评判各个选项，这就留给智能体自行选择评判标准。我们考察了两个此类智能体（分别基于OpenAI和Anthropic的模型构建）如何解读用户声明的优先级。在36次运行中，智能体对微软和Alphabet这两家公司进行了比较。提示词要求特别关注增长或韧性，或者不给出任何优先级。我们分析了报告、搜索、返回的来源以及被引用的来源。在给定优先级的24份报告中，有21份聚焦于该优先级，但它们所采用的评判标准各不相同。在增长优先级下，OpenAI的报告在为公司排名时考虑了风险或可预测性，因而更青睐微软，而Anthropic的报告则以增长速度来评判增长，因而更青睐Alphabet。在韧性优先级下，各报告使用了部分不同的标准，且大多数将微软列为……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文研究了基于OpenAI和Anthropic模型的网络研究智能体在用户仅给出模糊优先级时如何自行选择评判标准，发现尽管智能体大多会聚焦于声明的优先级，但其采用的标准差异很大，甚至导致在微软与Alphabet的比较中得出截然相反的结论。
en_tdlr: This paper examines how web research agents built on OpenAI and Anthropic models interpret vague user priorities such as "growth" or "resilience," finding that while agents generally focus on the stated priority, they adopt widely varying evaluation criteria that lead to divergent conclusions when comparing Microsoft and Alphabet.
